(2) She raises one, then two, and three fingers as she presents different customs, accompanied by floating illustrations of traditional Chinese foods like rice cakes, dumplings, and long noodles. (3) A graphic showing a red envelope appears as she gestures toward the screen with her palms together. (4) She holds up fingers to indicate another point while visuals of gold ingots and a red lantern are superimposed on the screen. (5) She demonstrates how to place spring couplets using her hands while images of characters like "Spring," "Blessing," and "Prosperity" appear on the screen. (6) She holds up her fingers for the final section of advice, smiling warmly at the camera.
